```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload")
    if payload is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing payload")
    
    nodes = payload.get("nodes")
    required_symbols = payload.get("required_symbols")
    
    if nodes is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing nodes")
    if required_symbols is None:
        raise ValueError("Missing required_symbols")
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node")
    
    # Build children map
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node["parent"]
        if parent is not None:
            if parent not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {parent} not found")
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    
    # Check required symbols can be satisfied
    all_symbols = {n["symbol"] for n in nodes}
    for sym in required_symbols:
        if sym not in all_symbols:
            raise ValueError(f"Required symbol {sym} not in tree")
    
    # Sort candidates: depth descending, then ID ascending
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removal_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Can't remove if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Can't remove if has retained children
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Check if removing would still keep all required symbols
        # After removing nid, what symbols remain?
        retained_after = retained - {nid}
        remaining_symbols = {node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained_after}
        
        if all(sym in remaining_symbols for sym in required_symbols):
            retained.discard(nid)
            removal_order.append(nid)
    
    sorted_retained = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted_retained,
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```
